title: Engagement Input Steals Typing Focus
description: Fix UI where all keyboard input is routed into the window engagement command field instead of the focused control. Align typing-target detection with replIsQueryTypingTarget and stop Engagement auto-focus from stealing focus from other inputs while active.
summary:
Fixed keyboard input being hijacked by the window engagement command field.

- Added isUiTypingTarget (text inputs, textareas, selects, contenteditable, collapsed fields, command/select surfaces, engagement fields).
- shouldRouteKeysToWindowEngagement now skips routing when focus or target is any UI typing surface.
- Engagement auto-focus runs only on inactive→active transition and does not steal focus from other inputs.
- CAD replIsQueryTypingTarget delegates to isUiTypingTarget.

Tests: @ui/react 95 passed, @cad/js/renderer replIsQueryTypingTarget passed.
